subject.title: [Bug]: Regression: User-configured heartbeat prompt no longer respected

question: Should maintainers refresh the dirty external fork PR that closes this issue, or close/supersede it and allow a narrow same-repo repair?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but an open unmergeable external fork PR has closing syntax and the issue is already marked no-new-fix-pr, so automation should not start another fix path without maintainer direction.

options.title: Replace With Same-Repo Repair
options.body: Close or supersede the dirty external fork path and sponsor a focused OpenClaw PR with the custom-prompt guard plus prompt-boundary tests.

options.title: Refresh The Fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author or a maintainer to rebase it, provide proof, and make it reviewable despite maintainerCanModify=false.

options.title: Hold For Owner Triage
options.body: Keep the issue open without new repair work until a heartbeat owner decides the exact fix shape.

recommendation.title: Replace With Same-Repo Repair
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the dirty external fork path and sponsor a focused OpenClaw PR with the custom-prompt guard plus prompt-boundary tests.

likelyOwner.reason: vignesh07 introduced the implicated hint behavior and opened the first maintainer fix attempt for this regression.
